title: Haunting Adeline
author: H. D. Carlton
summary: A woman who inherits her grandmother’s house finds she is being followed by a man who is both threatening and strangely protective. The dark romance that follows plays with obsession and a criminal underworld.
readIf: you want an extreme dark romance and are comfortable with intense, non-consensual themes.
skipIf: you want a gentle or realistic love story, because this one deals in stalking and graphic violence.

pairings.reason: A mainstream thriller-romance with a twist that also explores obsession and manipulation.
A disturbing and literary thriller about a damaged woman and violence.
A thriller with a dark underbelly and a protagonist intent on justice.
